cases.expected: ObjectMapper instance returned by getJsonMapper() (same reference as JsonSchemaFactory#getJsonMapper)
cases.description: When InputFormat.JSON is supplied, the method should take the first branch and return the JSON ObjectMapper.

cases.expected: ObjectMapper instance returned by getYamlMapper() (same reference as JsonSchemaFactory#getYamlMapper)
cases.description: When InputFormat.YAML is supplied the method should take the second branch and return the YAML ObjectMapper. The returned instance must be identical (==) to the one produced by the private getYamlMapper() helper.

cases.expected: IllegalArgumentException with message containing "Unsupported input format null"
cases.description: Passing a null InputFormat should not match JSON or YAML branches; the method must throw IllegalArgumentException indicating the format is unsupported.

cases.expected: IllegalArgumentException with message containing "Unsupported input format CUSTOM"
cases.description: If an enum constant other than JSON or YAML (e.g., a hypothetical CUSTOM value) is supplied, the method must fall through to the default case and throw IllegalArgumentException.
